text: Grab's FY2025 report states that media reports indicate the Indonesian government is considering a draft presidential decree that would lower the current maximum commission Grab can charge driver-partners. Currently, under MOT Decree No. 667 of 2022 (as amended), there is a 20% cap composed of a 15% commission cap plus a 5% optional supporting fee cap. If adopted as reported, the draft decree would reduce this to a flat 10% commission cap — in addition to reclassifying driver-partners as quasi-employees (requiring Grab to fund accident/death insurance and contribute to health, old-age, and pension premiums), allowing government review of driver-partner agreements, and protecting unionization rights [Grab, FY2025, p.16].
